articles.title: Resetting your password
articles.body:
If you forgot your password, open the login page and click "Forgot password?". Enter the email address of your account and we send you a reset link. The link is valid for 30 minutes.

Didn't get the email? Check your spam folder, and make sure you typed the address you registered with. You can request a new link after 5 minutes.

For security, resetting your password signs you out on all other devices.

articles.title: Signing in with your company account (SSO)
articles.body:
Teams on the Business plan can sign in with their company account (single sign-on) instead of a password. Your administrator enables it under Settings > Security > Single sign-on.

If everyone in your company suddenly gets "invalid session" after entering their password, your identity provider's certificate has probably expired. Your administrator must upload the new certificate under Settings > Security > Single sign-on. Until then, administrators can still sign in with their own password.

Users who are not in your identity provider can't sign in with SSO.

articles.title: Downloading invoices
articles.body:
Invoices are under Billing > Invoices. Each month's invoice is available as a PDF on the first working day of the following month.

If the Invoices page stays blank, clear your browser cache or try a private window. Ad blockers sometimes block the PDF viewer.

Only users with the Billing role can see invoices. Ask your account owner to give you the role if you need it.

articles.title: Refunds and duplicate charges
articles.body:
If your card was charged twice for the same subscription period, contact support with the date and amount of both charges. Duplicate charges are refunded within 5 to 10 business days to the original payment method.

We don't refund partial months when you cancel or downgrade a plan; the change takes effect at the end of the billing period.

Refunds can only go back to the card that was charged, not to another card or a bank account.

articles.title: Exporting reports as CSV
articles.body:
Every report can be exported. Open the report, click the three-dot menu in the top right corner and choose Export > CSV. Large reports are emailed to you as a download link instead of downloading directly.

CSV files use commas as separators and UTF-8 encoding. To open them in Excel with the right characters, use Data > From Text/CSV rather than double-clicking the file.

articles.title: Changing your time zone
articles.body:
Your time zone controls how dates and times are shown. Change it on your Profile page under Preferences > Time zone, then click Save.

Known issue: on the Settings page, the Save button for the time zone currently does nothing. Use the Profile page instead until it's fixed.

Administrators can set a default time zone for new users under Settings > Organization.

articles.title: Connecting to the VPN
articles.body:
Install the latest VPN client from the Downloads page and sign in with your company email. The client connects automatically when you start your computer.

After a client update, connections can fail with "authentication failed" until you sign out of the client and sign in again.

The VPN does not work on guest Wi-Fi networks that block UDP port 1194; use a mobile hotspot to test whether that's the cause.
